title: SEC3: message-id extraction duplicated in queue.rs vs relay_queue.rs
description: queue.rs and relay_queue.rs both implement extract_message_id logic with different approaches. queue.rs uses a strip_field_name helper with case-insensitive prefix matching; relay_queue.rs hardcodes field name length (11 bytes) and manually indexes bytes. Consolidating to a shared helper in stoa-core or a local util module would reduce maintenance risk and ensure consistent behavior.
